mapper.insert: insert into mq_outbox (order_id, order_number, payload, status, retry_count, create_time, send_time) values (#{orderId}, #{orderNumber}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime}, #{sendTime})
mapper.select: select id, order_id, order_number, payload, status, retry_count, create_time, send_time from mq_outbox where status = 0 order by create_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update mq_outbox set status = 1, send_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
update mq_outbox set status = 2, retry_count = retry_count + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 0
update mq_outbox set retry_count = retry_count + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 0
